title: Bracket Balance
summary: Validate a sequence of three bracket types.
statement: Return whether every opening bracket is closed by the matching type in last-opened, first-closed order.
hints: Nested structures are naturally last-in, first-out.
Push openings and compare every closing bracket with the stack top.
Reject a closer when the stack is empty or the popped opener has the wrong type.
A stack gives one-pass validation; it must be empty at the end.
editorial: Use a stack for opening brackets and a map from closing to opening bracket. Each closer must match the most recent opener.

tests.explanation: Three adjacent bracket pairs are all balanced.
The closing parenthesis arrives while the square bracket is still open, so the nesting is invalid.
